title: Seafood Tagine
description: A hearty seafood stew originating from North Africa, made with a blend of spices and quintessential tagine flavors.

ingredients.name: Quintessential tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

ingredients.name: Seafood broth
ingredients.notes: Chicken or vegetable broth can be substituted

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy pot over medium heat.
Add the onions, ginger, and garlic and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the fish, mussels, clams, and seafood broth to the pot.
Stir in the quintessential tagine spice mix and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the seafood is cooked through.
Stir in the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
